initiative-brief.name: $PROJECT_NAME
initiative-brief.desired-outcome: A decision: proceed, pivot, or kill — backed by evidence.

success-metrics.metric: Clear go/no-go decision with supporting data

constraints.item: Timebox: $TOTAL_TIMEBOX (hard stop — discovery must produce a decision within this window)

non-goals.item: Production-grade implementation (this is discovery, not delivery)

context-assessment.uncertainty: Discovery exists because uncertainty is too high for confident delivery planning. The goal is to reduce uncertainty to actionable levels.
context-assessment.dependency-density: Discovery work should be decoupled from production systems. Use stubs, prototypes, and sandboxes.
context-assessment.work-arrival: Discovery is timeboxed by design. Each experiment is a small batch.

primary.rationale: Highest uncertainty demands build-measure-learn loops and timeboxed research.
primary.discovery: Test assumptions, not whole ideas. Most assumption tests run in 1-2 days, not weeks.
primary.structure: Desired outcome -> customer opportunities -> candidate solutions -> assumption tests.
primary.cadence: Weekly customer touchpoints by the team building the product.

anti-patterns.item: Feature factory: discovery is about validated learning, not building. Kill ideas that don't validate.
Estimate-as-promise: discovery timebox is a budget, not a delivery commitment.
Framework orthodoxy: discovery is inherently messy. Don't over-process it.

spike.question: $TECHNICAL_QUESTION
spike.output: Decision document with benchmark data / prototype / proof-of-concept
spike.follow-on: If validated: create delivery slices. If invalidated: explore alternatives or kill.

team-structure.recommended-size: Discovery teams are small and fast. Product trio: PM + Designer + Engineer.
team-structure.topology: Engineers must participate in discovery. PMs must stay hands-on. No handoffs.

estimation.approach: Discovery is budgeted, not estimated. Set a timebox and work within it. Outcome is a decision, not a deliverable.
estimation.warning: Do not estimate discovery work with story points or detailed breakdowns. It is inherently uncertain — that is the point.

phase.name: frame
phase.goal: Map assumptions. Prioritize by risk. Design first experiments.

phase.name: test
phase.goal: Run experiments on riskiest assumptions. Collect evidence.

phase.name: decide
phase.goal: Synthesize evidence. Make proceed/pivot/kill decision. If proceed: hand off to delivery planning (greenfield or brownfield context).

handoff-to-delivery.output: Validated assumptions, delivery scope recommendation, initial epic breakdown, and risk profile for delivery planning.
handoff-to-delivery.next-context: greenfield or brownfield depending on whether building new or extending existing.
